enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Shift legs. Roll onto back. Place arm over forehead. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down. Remain still.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Close cabinet. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off shirt. Take off pants. Put on work shirt. Put on work pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place laptop inside. Place notebook inside. Place pen inside. Place water bottle inside. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Place backpack on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take out scrubs. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient list. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Walk to patient room 2. Enter room. Administer medication. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Return to nurse station. Update records. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient care. Walk to break room. Sit down. Eat lunch. Return to nurse station. Continue patient rounds. Walk to patient room 3. Check patient. Walk to exit. Change out of scrubs. Walk out of hospital.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up meat. Season meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe counter. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Navigate to website. Read articles. Watch videos. Click links. Type comment. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Save game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to couch. Sit on couch.

Walk to living room. Pick up book from shelf. Sit on couch. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Press play. Put down phone. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Put down book. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink water. Pick up book. Read pages. Close book. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on pajamas. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with phone and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off light. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Shift legs. Move arm. Sigh. Roll onto back. Remain still.
